title: Factory Repairs
statementMd:
A factory produces thimbles in bulk. Typically, it can produce up to $*a*$ thimbles a day. However, some of the machinery is defective, so it can currently only produce $*b*$ thimbles each day. The factory intends to choose a $*k*$-day period to do maintenance and construction; it cannot produce any thimbles during this time, but will be restored to its full production of $*a*$ thimbles per day after the $*k*$ days are complete.

Initially, no orders are pending. The factory receives updates of the form $*d*_{*i*}$, $*a*_{*i*}$, indicating that $*a*_{*i*}$ new orders have been placed for the $*d*_{*i*}$-th day. Each order requires a single thimble to be produced on precisely the specified day. The factory may opt to fill as many or as few of the orders in a single batch as it likes.

As orders come in, the factory owner would like to know the maximum number of orders he will be able to fill if he starts repairs on a given day $*p*_{*i*}$. Help the owner answer his questions.

## Input

The first line contains five integers $*n*$, $*k*$, $*a*$, $*b*$, and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$, $1 ≤ *b* < *a* ≤ 10 000$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of days, the length of the repair time, the production rates of the factory, and the number of updates, respectively.

The next $*q*$ lines contain the descriptions of the queries. Each query is of one of the following two forms:

- $1 *d*_{*i*} *a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10 000$), representing an update of $*a*_{*i*}$ orders on day $*d*_{*i*}$, or
- $2 *p*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - *k* + 1$), representing a question: at the moment, how many orders could be filled if the factory decided to commence repairs on day $*p*_{*i*}$?

It's guaranteed that the input will contain at least one query of the second type.

## Output

For each query of the second type, print a line containing a single integer — the maximum number of orders that the factory can fill over all $*n*$ days.

## Note

Consider the first sample.

We produce up to $1$ thimble a day currently and will produce up to $2$ thimbles a day after repairs. Repairs take $2$ days.

For the first question, we are able to fill $1$ order on day $1$, no orders on days $2$ and $3$ since we are repairing, no orders on day $4$ since no thimbles have been ordered for that day, and $2$ orders for day $5$ since we are limited to our production capacity, for a total of $3$ orders filled.

For the third question, we are able to fill $1$ order on day $1$, $1$ order on day $2$, and $2$ orders on day $5$, for a total of $4$ orders.
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

一家工厂批量生产顶针。通常情况下，它每天最多可以生产 $*a*$ 个顶针。然而，由于部分机器发生故障，目前每天只能生产 $*b*$ 个顶针。工厂计划选择一个长度为 $*k*$ 天的时间段进行维修和建设；在此期间不能生产任何顶针，但在这 $*k*$ 天结束后，工厂将恢复到每天生产 $*a*$ 个顶针的完整产能。

初始时没有待处理的订单。工厂会收到形如 $*d*_{*i*}$、$*a*_{*i*}$ 的更新，表示第 $*d*_{*i*}$ 天新增了 $*a*_{*i*}$ 个订单。每个订单都要求在指定的那一天生产一个顶针。工厂可以自行决定在一天内完成这一批订单中的任意数量。

随着订单不断到来，工厂老板希望知道：如果从指定的第 $*p*_{*i*}$ 天开始维修，最多能够完成多少个订单。请帮助老板回答这些问题。

## 输入格式

第一行包含五个整数 $*n*$、$*k*$、$*a*$、$*b*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n* ≤ 200 000$, $1 ≤ *b* < *a* ≤ 10 000$, $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$）——分别表示天数、维修持续时间、工厂的生产速率以及更新的数量。

接下来 $*q*$ 行描述查询。每个查询为以下两种形式之一：

- $1 *d*_{*i*} *a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *d*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10 000$），表示第 $*d*_{*i*}$ 天新增了 $*a*_{*i*}$ 个订单；
- $2 *p*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *p*_{*i*} ≤ *n* - *k* + 1$），表示一个询问：在当前时刻，如果工厂决定从第 $*p*_{*i*}$ 天开始维修，最多可以完成多少个订单？

保证输入中至少包含一个第二种查询。

## 输出格式

对于每个第二种查询，输出一行一个整数——在全部 $*n*$ 天内，工厂最多能够完成的订单数量。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。

目前我们每天最多生产 1 个顶针，维修后每天最多生产 2 个顶针。维修需要 2 天。

对于第一个询问，我们可以在第 1 天完成 1 个订单；由于正在维修，第 2 天和第 3 天无法完成订单；第 4 天没有当天的订单，因此也无法完成订单；第 5 天受生产能力限制，可以完成 2 个订单。因此总共完成 3 个订单。

对于第三个询问，我们可以在第 1 天完成 1 个订单，在第 2 天完成 1 个订单，并在第 5 天完成 2 个订单，总共完成 4 个订单。
